Antwerp bureau: De Beers raises its own output guidance and cuts its unit cost, even as its CEO calls the sale market "challenging."

Antwerpen: De Beers verhoogt zijn jaarprognose en verlaagt de kostprijs per karaat, net nu de topman de verkoopmarkt "uitdagend" noemt.

Q3 output fell 11% to 6.8 million carats. Full-year guidance: 25-28 million carats, up from 21-26 million, at c.$70 a carat, down from c.$80.
